name: document-proof-or-stop-framework-reimplementation-contract
title: Document the complete Proof-or-Stop domain and lifecycle contract for an equivalent reimplementation
description: Create an implementation-independent specification of Proof-or-Stop's core philosophy, domain language, evidence and admissibility model, complete lifecycle, artifact schemas, writer and consumer boundaries, transition gates, failure semantics, and reimplementation acceptance criteria. The result must let another engineering team build a new framework that preserves the same process and proof semantics without copying the current TypeScript architecture blindly.
